design_philosophy: Engineered, trustworthy, fluid, protective, premium, modern industrial, intelligent. Cinematic dark premium 3D hero, transitioning to clean/light trust-focused body sections. Asymmetrical layouts, editorial spacing, strong hierarchy.

typography.alignment: Left-aligned preferred for text blocks. Center alignment only used for specific high-impact moments.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids, asymmetrical span logic. Avoid identical 3-column rows.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for light mode only. Dark mode uses borders.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#0B0F1A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 text-white

primary.classes: bg-[#F57C1F] text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold tracking-wide uppercase hover:bg-[#E06A12] transition-colors rounded-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center data-testid="primary-cta"

secondary.classes: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold tracking-wide uppercase hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors rounded-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center data-testid="secondary-cta"

cards.service_card: Solid background, 1px subtle border, sharp corners or max 4px radius. Content left-aligned. No centered icons in colored circles. Use high-quality photos or crisp structural icons on the left.
cards.testimonial_card: Minimalist, no heavy quotes, clean typography, text-muted for role/location.

forms.inputs: Flat surfaces, bottom border only or sharp 1px full border. bg-surface_light text-text_dark focus:border-accent_orange focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent_orange transition-all

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling recommended for premium momentum feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Framer Motion: fade up with slight y-axis translation (y: 20) and opacity (0 to 1) stagger.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons and links have color transitions. Service cards have slight dark overlay lift or border color shift.
motion_and_interactions.hero_3d: Use React Three Fiber or a high-quality video loop for fluid flowing through a protected channel.

page_sections_strategy.hero: Cinematic Dark Mode. Large H1, immersive fluid flow visual. Deep slate/navy background with high contrast orange CTA.
page_sections_strategy.trust_bar: Dark mode strip directly under hero. Client/Partner logos in monochrome white/opacity-50.
page_sections_strategy.problem_agitation: Transition to Light Mode. Sharp contrast. Show real flooded yards.
page_sections_strategy.how_it_works: Light Mode. Step timeline with engineering diagrams or precise photography of trenches.
page_sections_strategy.services: Light Mode Bento Grid. Mixing tall and wide cards. No equal 3-column rows.
page_sections_strategy.case_studies: Before/After sliders or high-contrast image grids. Light Mode or Dark Accent Section.
page_sections_strategy.lead_capture: Dark Mode Footer/Contact section to bookend the page. Deep navy surface, high contrast form.

hero_texture_abstract.description: Abstract fluid flow for hero fallback

problem_flooded_yard.description: House on wet road, representing water pooling

results_landscaped.description: Tranquil landscaped backyard representing the solution
